d14HJLgUrMu7aAlZBkLaUA.zh: 歐盟今年7月共計13國報告118例確定病例,以保加利亞(61 例)、義大利(29例)、西班牙(7例)、波蘭(7例)及比利時(4例)為多。近12個月(2025/8/1-2026/7/31)共計30國報告2,339例病例,其中2,012例(86.0%)經實驗室確診。個案集中於15歲(含)以上(51.2%)。ECDC評估疫情主因為部分國家疫苗覆蓋率不足、境外移入等因素,並呼籲各國提升疫苗覆蓋率至95%以上。 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至9/5(第35週),計17個國家/地區累計報告52,676例確定病例及61例死亡(CFR:0.12%),較去年同期病例數增加約3.8倍。有99.5%的病例集中於瓜地馬拉(33,334 例)、墨西哥(12,848例)、美國(3,134例)、秘魯(1,997例)及加拿大(1,119例);泛美衛生組織(PAHO)預計今年11月進行評估墨西哥消除麻疹認證。
d14HJLgUrMu7aAlZBkLaUA.en: In July this year, 13 EU countries reported a total of 118 confirmed cases, mainly Bulgaria (61), Italy (29), Spain (7), Poland (7) and Belgium (4). Over the past 12 months (1 August 2025–31 July 2026), 30 countries reported 2,339 cases, of which 2,012 (86.0%) were laboratory-confirmed. Cases are concentrated among people aged 15 and over (51.2%). The ECDC attributes the outbreaks mainly to insufficient vaccination coverage in some countries and imported cases, and calls on countries to raise vaccination coverage to above 95%. In the Americas, as of 5 September this year (week 35), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 52,676 confirmed cases and 61 deaths (CFR 0.12%), about 3.8 times the number in the same period last year. Some 99.5% of cases were concentrated in Guatemala (33,334), Mexico (12,848), the United States (3,134), Peru (1,997) and Canada (1,119). PAHO plans to assess Mexico's measles elimination certification in November this year.

iw1z7K0j7F6qPHRAhx-a2A.zh: 歐洲今年截至9/3共15國累計報告1,086例本土病例,其中61例死亡(CFR:6%),病例數超過過去10年同期平均(736例),病例以義大利(516例)、希臘(284例)及西班牙(88例) 等國為多,荷蘭為2020年以來首次報告人類病例。另亦有持續報告鳥類及馬科動物群聚疫情,雖尚無跡象顯示疾病嚴重度增加,當局評估當前氣候條件有利於病媒蚊傳播,預期未來數週病例數仍將持續上升。
iw1z7K0j7F6qPHRAhx-a2A.en: As of 3 September this year, 15 European countries have cumulatively reported 1,086 locally acquired cases, including 61 deaths (CFR 6%). The case count exceeds the average of 736 for the same period over the past 10 years. Cases are concentrated in Italy (516), Greece (284) and Spain (88), among others; the Netherlands reported its first human case since 2020. Bird and equine cluster outbreaks continue to be reported. Although there is no sign that disease severity is increasing, authorities assess that current climatic conditions favour mosquito-borne transmission, and case numbers are expected to keep rising in the coming weeks.

LJ2220cWWpJUxGTtFu4TAQ.zh: 歐洲今年截至8/5共有7國累計報告245例病例,其中12例死亡(CFR:5%),病例以義大利(139例)、希臘(65例)及西班牙(17例) 等國為多,患者多為65歲以上男性,72%需住院治療。目前疫情低於過去10年同期平均(403例),惟地理擴散範圍更廣,且多國新增首次報告本土病例的地區。該疾病傳播季節為每年5 至11月,當局評估當前氣候條件有利於病媒蚊傳播,預估於8-9月人類與動物病例數將持續增加。
LJ2220cWWpJUxGTtFu4TAQ.en: As of 5 August this year, seven European countries had cumulatively reported 245 cases, of which 12 died (CFR 5%). Cases are concentrated in Italy (139), Greece (65) and Spain (17), among others. Patients are mostly men aged over 65, and 72% required hospitalisation. The current outbreak is below the same-period average of the past 10 years (403 cases), but geographic spread is wider, and several countries have reported locally acquired cases for the first time in new areas. The transmission season for this disease is May to November each year. Authorities assess that current climatic conditions favour mosquito-borne transmission, and human and animal cases are expected to continue rising in August and September.

nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年6/30累計145國/地區報告18萬8,565例確定病例,其中521例死亡。 今年6月共計33國家/地區報告1,128例確定病例,其中9例死亡(CFR:0.8%),以馬達加斯加(546例)、美國(111例)、剛果⺠主共和國(86例)、英國(46例)及葡萄牙(45例)為高,64%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年5月,美洲區及東南亞區病例數呈上升趨勢,其餘地區疫情則下降;東地中海區則無通報病例。哥斯大黎加、迦納及立陶宛通報首例Ib型病例;幾內亞比索首度通報3例IIb型病例。 非洲地區近6週(6/8-7/19)共計10國報告1,112例確定病例,其中12例死亡(CFR:1.1%),以馬達加斯加(940例)、安哥拉(57例)、肯亞(48例)、剛果⺠主共和國(30例)及喀麥隆(24例)為高。 非洲以外地區,共11國報告Ib型社區傳播;近6週報告Ib型病例最多國家為葡萄牙(60例),其次為英國(31例)、泰國(29例)、法國(18例)及西班牙(16例)。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月起爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情,截至7/19,累計報告2,921例確定病例及18例死亡(CFR:0.6%)。疫情擴及全國61%行政區(70/115),主要影響15-49歲族群。雖已推動MVA-BN疫苗接種(89,723人施打第1劑),惟因檢測陽性率由65%上升至74%,以及面臨疫苗缺貨、冷鏈物流、醫療量能與風險溝通等挑戰,疫情迄未受到控制。 安哥拉自今年5月中旬起疫情升溫,截至7/19累計108例確定病例及1例死亡(CFR 0.9%),主要集中於Cabinda省(佔80%),52%病例為20-29歲族群,其中女性及女童比例高達66%,當局已啟動相關防治措施。
nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 30 June this year, 145 countries and territories have reported 188,565 confirmed mpox cases, including 521 deaths. In June this year, 33 countries and territories reported 1,128 confirmed cases, including 9 deaths (CFR: 0.8%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (546), the United States (111), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (86), the United Kingdom (46) and Portugal (45), and 64% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with May this year, case numbers rose in the Region of the Americas and the South-East Asia Region and declined in other regions; the Eastern Mediterranean Region reported no cases. Costa Rica, Ghana and Lithuania reported their first clade Ib cases, and Guinea-Bissau reported 3 clade IIb cases for the first time. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (8 June–19 July), 10 countries reported 1,112 confirmed cases, including 12 deaths (CFR: 1.1%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (940), Angola (57), Kenya (48), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30) and Cameroon (24). Outside Africa, 11 countries have reported clade Ib community transmission. Over the past 6 weeks, the countries reporting the most clade Ib cases were Portugal (60), the United Kingdom (31), Thailand (29), France (18) and Spain (16). Madagascar has experienced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 19 July, 2,921 confirmed cases and 18 deaths (CFR: 0.6%) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 61% of the country's administrative areas (70 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15–49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has begun (89,723 people have received the first dose), the test positivity rate has risen from 65% to 74%, and challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics, health system capacity and risk communication remain, so the outbreak is not yet under control. Angola's outbreak has intensified since mid-May this year. As of 19 July, 108 confirmed cases and 1 death (CFR: 0.9%) have been reported cumulatively, mainly concentrated in Cabinda Province (80%). Of cases, 52% are aged 20–29 years, and females and girls account for as much as 66%. Authorities have launched related prevention and control measures.

YTUbkjY0L6sJBx3Pa1NykA.zh: 西班牙今年截至7/15累計報告2例病例,其中1例死亡(84歲女性) ,病患發病日介於6/11-7/8。西班牙為歐洲今年迄今唯一報告疫情的國家,另2016-2024年累計報告16例病例。歐洲CDC評估目前疫情與過往6-8月季節性疫情趨勢一致,感染重症需住院者中約有30%會致命。
YTUbkjY0L6sJBx3Pa1NykA.en: As of 15 July this year, Spain has reported 2 cases cumulatively, including 1 death (an 84-year-old woman), with onset dates between 11 June and 8 July. Spain is the only European country to have reported cases so far this year. From 2016 to 2024, 16 cases were reported cumulatively. The European CDC assesses that the current outbreak is consistent with the seasonal trend of previous June–August outbreaks, and that about 30% of severe infections requiring hospitalization are fatal.

jGKYoFtOUgZ4gLWQpheXrA.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年5/31累計144國/地區報告18萬5,882例確定病例,其中509例死亡。 今年5月共計32國家/地區報告1,142例確定病例,其中3例死亡(CFR 0.3%),以馬達加斯加(649例)、中國(89例)、法國(63例)、澳洲(50例)及德國(45例)為高,63.9%的病例來自非洲地區。相較今年4月,西太平洋區及非洲區病例數呈上升趨勢 ,其餘地區疫情則下降,挪威通報首例Ib型病例,另波蘭先前的I型病例確定為Ib型次分支。 非洲地區近6週(5/4-6/14)共計10國報告790例確定病例,其中3 例死亡(CFR 0.45%),以馬達加斯加、肯亞、幾內亞、南蘇丹、喀麥隆及剛果⺠主共和國為高;非洲以外地區,為西班牙與泰國持續報告Ib型社區傳播。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月以來面臨全球最大規模的Ib型疫情,截至今年6/14,累計2,117例確定病例與7例死亡(多為免疫低下者)。疫情已擴及全國60%的行政區(69/115),主要影響15-49 歲族群。雖已推動MVA-BN疫苗接種(超過7.9萬人施打),惟面臨疫苗缺貨、冷鏈物流與醫療量能挑戰,疫情迄未受到控制。
jGKYoFtOUgZ4gLWQpheXrA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 31 May this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 185,882 confirmed cases, including 509 deaths. In May this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.3%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (649), China (89), France (63), Australia (50) and Germany (45), and 63.9% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with April this year, case numbers rose in the Western Pacific and African Regions and declined in other regions. Norway reported its first clade Ib case, and Poland's earlier clade I case has been identified as a clade Ib sub-lineage. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (4 May–14 June), 10 countries reported 790 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.45%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar, Kenya, Guinea, South Sudan, Cameroon and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Outside Africa, Spain and Thailand continued to report clade Ib community transmission. Madagascar has faced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 14 June this year, 2,117 confirmed cases and 7 deaths (mostly among immunocompromised people) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 60% of the country's administrative areas (69 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15 to 49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has been rolled out (more than 79,000 people vaccinated), the outbreak remains uncontrolled because of challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics and health system capacity.

z8yLb29WscLB_zR8c2jXyQ.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至 6/2 累計 363 例確定病例(62 例死亡、6 例康復),疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共 25 個衛生區,其中重災區伊圖里省新增曼巴薩(Mambasa)衛生區,DRC 接觸者追蹤率僅約 45.5%。 西班牙取消 DRC 國家足球隊的世界盃熱身賽;美國要求 DRC 國家足球隊在入境參與世界盃前,必須先完成 21 天隔離。
z8yLb29WscLB_zR8c2jXyQ.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 2 June, 363 confirmed cases have been reported (62 deaths, 6 recovered), concentrated in 25 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Within the heavily affected Ituri Province, Mambasa health zone has been newly added. DRC's contact tracing rate is only about 45.5%. Spain has cancelled the DRC national football team's World Cup warm-up match. The United States requires the DRC national football team to complete 21 days of quarantine before entering to take part in the World Cup.

TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022 年截至今年4/30 累計144 國/地區報告18 萬4,531例確診病例,其中,至少506例死亡。 非洲地區近6週(4/6-5/17)通報確診病例數最高國家:馬達加斯加(780例)、幾內亞(40例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、肯亞(27例)、賴比瑞亞(17例)。 全球近6週(4/6-5/17)共有19個國家報告 Ib型病毒:   社區傳播共15國:馬達加斯加(780例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、巴基斯坦(29例)、肯亞(27例)、西班牙(18例)、德國(17例)、瑞士(14例)、葛摩/葡萄牙(6例)、斯洛伐克/剛果共和國(4例)、哥倫比亞(3例)、泰國/丹麥(2例)。 與旅遊相關(境外移入)共4 國:美國(5 例)、模里西斯(2 例)、臺灣/愛爾蘭(1例)。
TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 30 April this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 184,531 confirmed cases, of which at least 506 were fatal. In Africa, the countries reporting the most confirmed cases over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May) were Madagascar (780), Guinea (40), South Sudan (37), the DRC (35), Kenya (27) and Liberia (17). Globally, 19 countries have reported clade Ib virus over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May). Community transmission has been reported in 15 countries: Madagascar (780), South Sudan (37), DRC (35), Pakistan (29), Kenya (27), Spain (18), Germany (17), Switzerland (14), Comoros/Portugal (6), Slovakia/Republic of the Congo (4), Colombia (3), and Thailand/Denmark (2). Travel-associated (imported) cases have been reported in four countries: United States (5), Mauritius (2), and Taiwan/Ireland (1).

quhhCVgNYud1C9if8bpuug.zh: WHO更新「洪迪亞斯號」郵輪疫情資訊,截至5/30累計報告13例病例,其中3 例死亡(致死率為23%),報告病例中有11 例確診為漢他病毒安地斯型感染,2 例為可能病例,自WHO 前於5/13 公布疫情資訊以來,共新增3例包括加拿大、荷蘭及西班牙確診病例。截至5/22 已有逾600 名接觸者進行追蹤,其中53%為高風險接觸者。WHO評估此疫情事件對全球之風險為低。
quhhCVgNYud1C9if8bpuug.en: WHO has updated information on the outbreak linked to the MV Hondius cruise ship. As of 30 May, 13 cases had been reported cumulatively, including three deaths (CFR 23%). Of the reported cases, 11 were confirmed as Andes hantavirus infection and two were probable cases. Since WHO's previous update on 13 May, three new cases have been added, in Canada, the Netherlands and Spain. As of 22 May, more than 600 contacts had been traced, 53% of them high-risk contacts. WHO assesses the global risk from this event as low.

OAWZklntAmsIl1E5-Q6-5Q.zh: 西班牙於5/25新增報告1例自MV Hondius號郵輪撤離後確診之安地斯病毒(ANDV)病例。14名西班牙公民於5/10自特內裡費島撤離,並被送往醫院隔離。第1例於抵達後一天被發現(症狀輕微,正在康復中);第2例則於5/25被發現(無症狀,常規PCR篩檢發現),兩例患者均已被轉移至高級隔離病房。其餘接觸者自5/10起在醫院隔離 28 天,之後在家隔離共42天。
OAWZklntAmsIl1E5-Q6-5Q.en: Spain reported one new Andes virus (ANDV) case on 25 May, in a person evacuated from the MV Hondius cruise ship. Fourteen Spanish citizens were evacuated from Tenerife on 10 May and taken to hospital for isolation. The first case was detected one day after arrival (mild symptoms, now recovering). The second case was detected on 25 May (asymptomatic, found through routine PCR screening). Both patients have been moved to high-level isolation wards. The remaining contacts have been isolated in hospital for 28 days from 10 May, and then isolated at home for a total of 42 days.

4Oi2brFO7M5l1bTy5aA24A.zh: WHO公告該事件截至 5 月 8 日,共計通報 8 例病例(6 例確診及 2 例極可能病例),其中 3 例死亡(致死率為 38%)。共有 6 例經實驗室確診為漢他病毒感染,且均鑑定為安地斯病毒(Andes virus, ANDV)。該郵輪已停泊於西班牙加那利群島,並安排人員逐批下船,基於預防原則,WHO 建議高風險接觸者在最後一次暴露後,應進行為期 42 天的主動監測與居家或機構檢疫隔離。WHO 評估此事件對全球公共衛生風險為「低」,並將持續監測流行病學情況及更新風險評估,船上乘客與船員的風險則被評估為「中度」。
4Oi2brFO7M5l1bTy5aA24A.en: WHO reported that as of 8 May, eight cases had been notified for this event (six confirmed and two probable), of which three died (CFR 38%). Six cases were laboratory-confirmed as hantavirus infection, all identified as Andes virus (ANDV). The cruise ship has docked in the Canary Islands, Spain, and personnel are disembarking in batches. As a precautionary measure, WHO recommends that high-risk contacts undergo 42 days of active monitoring after their last exposure, followed by home or facility quarantine. WHO assesses the global public health risk from this event as low and will continue to monitor the epidemiological situation and update its risk assessment. The risk to passengers and crew on board is assessed as moderate.

oY8PHyY1gfEPGAOyW1qObw.zh: 日本疫情急遽上升,第 15 週單週新增 56 例確定病例,今年截至4/15 累計報告 299 例,其中 30 例為境外移入病例,感染國家以印及紐西蘭為多,年齡層以 15-29 年齡層為多(占 50%),分布以東京都 108 例、神奈川縣 31 例及鹿兒島縣 28 例為多,61%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,當局呼籲民眾確認兒童按時接種疫苗,另前往流行地區應採取相關防疫措施。 英國今年截至 4/13 累計報告 407 例確定病例,病例數以倫敦 229 例及西密德蘭郡(West Midlands)100 例為多,另所有地區皆有報告至少 1 例確定病例。該國去(2024)年報告 959 例確定病例。 歐盟今年 2 月共計 11 國報告 139 例確定病例,以義大利(63 例)、西班牙(36 例)為多。近 12 個月(2025/3/1-2026/2/28)共計 30 國報告 4,623 例病例,其中 6 例死亡,病例數以羅馬亞(1,587 例)、法國(754 例)、義大利(534 例)為多,其中 79.9%病患未接種疫苗。
oY8PHyY1gfEPGAOyW1qObw.en: Japan's outbreak has risen sharply: 56 confirmed cases were reported in week 15 alone, and as of 15 April this year, 299 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 30 were imported. The countries of infection were mainly India and New Zealand. Those aged 15–29 accounted for the largest share (50%). Cases were concentrated in Tokyo Metropolis (108), Kanagawa Prefecture (31) and Kagoshima Prefecture (28). 61% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Authorities urge the public to confirm that children are vaccinated on schedule and to take appropriate precautions when travelling to epidemic areas. The UK reported 407 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April. Cases are concentrated in London (229) and West Midlands County (100), and every region has reported at least one confirmed case. The UK reported 959 confirmed cases last year (2024). In February this year, 11 EU countries reported 139 confirmed cases, mainly Italy (63) and Spain (36). In the past 12 months (1 March 2025 to 28 February 2026), 30 countries reported 4,623 cases, including six deaths, with the largest numbers in Romania (1,587), France (754) and Italy (534); 79.9% of patients were unvaccinated.

In January this year, 50 countries and regions reported 1,334 new confirmed cases, including 3 deaths; 66% came from the African Region. Comoros and Réunion reported their first clade Ib cases. Genetic sequencing shows they are the same recombinant strain. WHO notes that actual case numbers may be higher than reported, but the clinical symptoms of the recombinant virus are consistent with ordinary lineages, none have been severe, and contact tracing has found no secondary cases; the overall risk assessment remains unchanged.

-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.en: PAHO issued a measles outbreak alert for the Americas. In weeks 1–3 of this year, 7 countries in the Americas reported 1,031 confirmed cases: Mexico (740), the United States (171), Canada (67), Guatemala (41), Bolivia (10), Chile (1) and Uruguay (1). This is a 43-fold increase over the 23 cases in the same period last year. Of these cases, 73% were unvaccinated and 11% had unknown vaccination history. Cases were mainly concentrated among adolescents and young adults, and incidence was highest among infants under 1 year, followed by children aged 1–4 and 5–9 years. Last year, 13 countries in the region reported 14,891 confirmed cases, compared with 466 in 2024; cases have continued to increase over the past five years, and many countries continue to report outbreaks. PAHO calls on countries to strengthen epidemiological surveillance, vaccination and emergency outbreak control measures to stop transmission. Europe reported 7,655 cases across 30 countries last year, including 8 deaths. Cases were most numerous in Romania (4,198), France (877), the Netherlands (534), Italy (529) and Spain (426). Of these, 79.9% were unvaccinated, and cases were most numerous among children under 5 years (40%). ECDC said last year's case numbers declined from 2024 (more than 35,000), but remain about twice the 2023 level. Because measles infections usually peak in late winter and early spring, it urges people to check that they have completed their vaccinations. Kazakhstan reported 1,951 confirmed cases in January this year, most in Astana (581), Zhambyl Region in the southeast (339) and Almaty city in the southeast (317). Of these, 79% were unvaccinated. Authorities say refusal of vaccination is the main cause of the outbreak, and urge parents to confirm children's vaccination status and vaccinate them promptly under the national immunization programme. The outbreak is severe in Aktobe Region in the west, which reported more than 100 cases in a single month, mainly among children under 3 years; 24 children are being treated in hospital.

R07oxC-uYwofyX-ew0jY3Q.en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 30 November 2025, 142 countries and areas have reported more than 175,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 467 deaths (CFR: 0.27%). In 2025 up to 30 November, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 206 deaths (CFR: 0.41%). In November 2025, 48 countries and areas reported 2,150 new confirmed cases, including 5 deaths (CFR: 0.27%); 68% came from the African Region. Compared with October, cases rose in the European and Western Pacific Regions and declined in other regions. In the African Region, over the past six weeks (2 November–14 December), 19 countries reported 1,435 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR: 0.5%). The highest numbers were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (427), Guinea (330), Liberia (176), Kenya (142) and Ghana (107). Except for Liberia, recent case numbers have declined in these countries. In the DRC, multiple provinces are experiencing clade Ia and Ib simultaneously, and in some provinces surveillance capacity is affected by security conditions and population movement, so cases may be underestimated. Outside Africa, Romania reported its first imported clade Ib case, in an adult male diagnosed in August this year who had travelled to China and had high-risk behaviour. He was hospitalised in isolation on arrival, no contacts were identified domestically, and no further cases have been reported. Spain and the Netherlands continue to report clade Ib community transmission. On 2 December, the United Kingdom reported 1 imported case, in which a recombinant MPXV strain containing gene segments of both clade Ib and clade IIb was detected. The case was mild, and there is currently insufficient information on the spread of this recombinant strain. Assessment and recommendations: WHO ended the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 5 September. However, because different genotypes continue to circulate in Africa, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, and funding and community resources are lacking, WHO still assesses the global transmission risk as moderate. Because asymptomatic infections and cases among travellers to affected areas were not detected promptly, clade Ib transmission risk persists. Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain and the United States, outside Africa, have been listed as areas of clade Ib community transmission. The risk to the general public is assessed as low, but as moderate for men who have sex with men (MSM), particularly those with non-fixed sexual partners. Countries are advised to improve testing capacity and complete epidemiological investigation and contact tracing, and high-risk people are urged to get vaccinated.

q-MJ3R-fOOCDxmf2Mbm1Kw.en: The ECDC reported that Europe recorded 6,558 food-related outbreak events in 2024, with 62,481 cases cumulatively, 3,336 hospitalisations and 53 deaths; the overall situation was higher than in 2023. Salmonella infection accounted for the largest share of food-related outbreaks, with 1,238 outbreaks. Most notifications came from France, the Netherlands, Spain and Belgium. Of these outbreaks, 65 clusters affected more than 100 people. Norovirus caused 631 outbreaks. Investigations found that common causes were cross-contamination, inadequate processing, insufficient heating and infected food handlers. Outbreaks most often occurred in schools, kindergartens, restaurants or workplaces.

K9ssijP-lRta8C7CLnSU4g.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年11/28累計142國/地區報告17萬2千餘例確診病例,其中至少467例死亡(CFR:0.27%)。 今年截至第48週累計99國/地區報告5萬1千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區4萬3千餘例、美洲區4,442例、歐洲區2,429例、西太平洋區1,479例、東南亞區154例及東地中海區46例。非洲、歐洲、西太平洋及中東區疫情下降;惟美洲及東南亞區病例數上升。  其他更新: 馬利西部庫利科羅11/24報告首例死亡病例,其餘資訊不明,當局已加強邊境監測並隔離疑病例。 評估與建議: WHO於9/5終止「國際關注之公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」,但因非洲不同基因型持續流行且監測及診斷能力不足,資金及社區資源不足,仍將全球傳播風險評估為中等。此次由於無症狀感染者和疫區旅遊者病例未即時發現,導致Ib型傳播風險持續,非洲外的義大利、荷蘭、葡萄牙、西班牙和美國已被列為Ib型社區傳播區。評估對一般民眾傳播風險為低,但對MSM群體為中,尤其未固定性伴侶族群,建議各國提高檢驗能力,並完整疫調追蹤,呼籲高風險者接種疫苗。
K9ssijP-lRta8C7CLnSU4g.en: Monthly update: Since May 2022 and as of 28 November this year, 142 countries and areas have reported more than 172,000 confirmed cases globally, of which at least 467 died (CFR 0.27%). Year to date as of week 48, 99 countries and areas have reported more than 51,000 confirmed cases: more than 43,000 in the African Region, 4,442 in the Region of the Americas, 2,429 in the European Region, 1,479 in the Western Pacific Region, 154 in the South-East Asia Region and 46 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Cases have declined in the African, European, Western Pacific and Eastern Mediterranean regions, but risen in the Americas and South-East Asia. Other updates: In Koulikoro, western Mali, the first death was reported on 24 November; other information is unknown. Authorities have strengthened border surveillance and isolated suspected cases. Assessment and recommendations: WHO ended the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 5 September. However, because different genotypes continue to circulate in Africa, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, and funding and community resources are inadequate, WHO still assesses the global transmission risk as moderate. Because cases among asymptomatic infected people and travelers from affected areas were not detected promptly, clade Ib transmission risk persists. Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain and the United States, outside Africa, have been listed as areas of clade Ib community transmission. The assessed risk to the general public is low, but moderate for men who have sex with men (MSM), especially those without a stable sexual partner. Countries are advised to improve testing capacity and complete contact tracing, and high-risk individuals are urged to get vaccinated.

TVHPzEM8IwAMP6va5L0eXA.en: Greece reported on 1 November its first imported clade Ib case; the patient had a travel history to the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and had engaged in MSM behaviour. Between 11 and 20 October, six European countries reported at least eight clade Ib cases: Germany and Italy 2 each, and Belgium, the Netherlands, Portugal and Spain 1 each. Two of these cases had no travel history, and three were in the MSM population, suggesting that undetected social transmission chains may exist among men who have sex with men and bisexual populations. Authorities assess the transmission risk in the MSM population as moderate and for the general public as low. The United Kingdom has recorded 3,732 cases cumulatively since 2022 as of 31 October this year, including 18 clade Ib cases, most of which are directly or indirectly linked to travel to countries with clade Ib transmission. The UK reported one new clade Ib case on 3 November, with a travel history to Thailand. Because the transmission risk among MSM in Europe and the Americas has recently increased, authorities have raised the assessed risk of importation and spread from moderate to high.

The patient is a 49-year-old man who developed a rash and swollen lymph nodes on 8 September. A specimen was collected on 18 September and confirmed on 22 September. The patient had travelled to Tanzania in August this year and had a high-risk contact history. He is isolating at home, and authorities have identified two contacts. Spain has reported 445 cases cumulatively this year as of 25 September. Authorities assess that, although travel-related infections continue to occur, the overall transmission risk is low.

UBnwJRPSP3Da6QWXWmad4w.zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共3國於2025/8/25-2025/8/29期間報告16起H5N1疫情,西班牙10起、保加利亞/挪威各3起。 共2國於2025/8/25-2025/8/29期間報告2起H5 (N untyped)疫情,挪威/法國各1起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,078起疫情,近期主要集中於加利福亞州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第34週計431個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中1州(奧勒岡州)共2個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感27例 (2003年迄今累計990*例)、H9N2流感18例(迄今累計146例)、H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽類/動物案例:累計57國家/地區通報2,204起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
UBnwJRPSP3Da6QWXWmad4w.en: Summary for the week. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): three countries reported 16 H5N1 outbreaks during 25–29 August 2025, including Spain (10), and Bulgaria and Norway (3 each). Two countries reported two H5 (N-untyped) outbreaks during 25–29 August 2025, Norway and France (1 each). Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: 1,078 herd outbreaks have been reported across 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated mainly in California. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, including a cat death. Wastewater monitoring: in week 34, 431 sampling sites provided results; two sampling sites in one state (Oregon) detected H5-positive samples. Annual summary. Human cases: H5N1 influenza, 27 cases (990 cumulatively since 2003); H9N2 influenza, 18 cases (146 cumulatively); H10N3 influenza, 2 cases (6 cumulatively); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Avian and animal cases: 57 countries and regions have cumulatively reported 2,204 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: On 28 July, FAO, WHO and WOAH completed a risk assessment of H5 viruses. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases were mostly associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as remaining low. Infection risk for the general public remains low; for people who often contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate. The main determinants are the mode of contact, duration, protective measures and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sector response.

7SB9FK0sqIkDoUqxTsbclg.en: Global outbreaks remain severe. Africa: so far this year, 7 countries have reported over 21,000 suspected cases, including over 3,600 confirmed and 54 deaths. Cases are concentrated in Morocco, which has reported over 20,000 cases and 37 deaths this year. Europe: ECDC has updated its measles data for January 2025. 17 countries reported 1,033 cases, of which Romania had 663, followed by Italy with 74 and Spain with 70; the remaining 14 countries reported 1–67 cases each. Several EU countries continue to have outbreaks. Cases surged last year, with over 32,000 reported for the full year, 19 of them fatal. ECDC says that based on seasonal patterns, case numbers are expected to keep rising this spring. Because most European countries have not reached full vaccination levels, it calls on countries to vaccinate actively. The Netherlands reported 63 cases so far this year up to February; most were imported cases and their contacts, mainly from Morocco and Romania. Asia: Hanoi, Viet Nam, added 120 cases in the past week (28 February–7 March), with 745 cases reported so far this year and none in the same period last year. Japan added 4 cases in week 9 (27 February–5 March), the highest this year; it has reported 9 cases cumulatively, mostly imported, and recently one imported case each from Viet Nam was reported in Chiba and Saitama prefectures. Americas: outbreaks continue in Texas and New Mexico, USA; as of 11 March, 256 cases had been reported this year (223 in Texas), of which 30 were hospitalized and 2 died. Los Angeles County reported its first case this year, in a patient with a travel history to Taiwan who returned on 5 March; investigation is ongoing. As of 21 February, 4 countries in the Americas had reported 268 cases this year, well above the 60 in the same period last year.

79E2RhAsSkAeiw7tVdBtbA.en:
The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 21 and 27 November, Pakistan added 6 WPV1 cases. For environmental samples, Pakistan added 24 WPV1-positive samples. In total, 2 countries added 2 cVDPV2-positive samples, one each in Algeria and Nigeria (GPEI, 28 November).

AbTGkZbaCpMjDS9z6eyZ5A.en: The Valencian Community in south-eastern Spain reported 3 new cases on 20 November. The patients live in different cities, but their places of residence had all recently been affected by DANA (an isolated upper-level low-pressure system bringing strong winds and heavy rain). Authorities say the disease spread through water supply systems after the DANA event, and urge people to take personal protective measures during cleaning work, stay alert and seek medical care early.

ESr57TYJ4H-ps9fprus8kA.zh: 西班牙北部帕倫西亞省今年累計報告102例病例,其中男性佔8成,以55至64歲年齡層為多,當局表示當地主要傳播媒介為田鼠,患者多係於農務或園藝過程暴露感染。
ESr57TYJ4H-ps9fprus8kA.en: Palencia Province in northern Spain has reported 102 cases cumulatively this year, 80% of them men, with most aged 55 to 64 years. Authorities say the main local transmission vector is voles, and most patients were exposed to infection during farm work or gardening.

iW_nRv9ehxq4zVQmFbH9aQ.en: Europe update: As of 6 November this year, 19 countries have cumulatively reported 1,375 locally acquired cases, mainly in Italy (449), Greece (217) and Spain (131). A cumulative 113 deaths have been reported, mainly in Greece (34), Romania (20) and Italy (18). Cumulative cases this year are higher than the same period last year (781), and most are men aged 65 and over.

xi3lbxj9752dvgCHVUuYAg.en: A school cluster of tuberculosis has been identified in the Extremadura Autonomous Community in western Spain. The first case was reported on 5 November, and 3 more cases were detected among contacts, bringing the cumulative total to 4 cases as of 11 November. Spain's incidence declined over the past decade but has risen slightly since 2022.

uI8I_Ote1J5BYM7XuYHXqA.en:
Italy has cumulatively reported 194 locally acquired cases this year, 456 imported cases and no deaths; last year the country reported 82 cases in total.

France has cumulatively reported 80 locally acquired cases this year, already higher than the 65 cases in 2022, a more severe year.

Spain has cumulatively reported 8 locally acquired cases this year, already exceeding the 6 cases recorded in 2018 and 2022, both years with higher case numbers.

unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.zh: 全球疫情更新,今年迄今累計超過1,300萬例病例及8,500例死亡:  美洲區病例數以巴西為多,其次為阿根廷、墨西哥、巴拉圭、哥倫比亞; 歐洲區法國、義大利、西班牙有報告病例; 東地中海區伊朗、阿富汗、巴基斯坦有報告病例; 東南亞區孟加拉及泊爾病例數上升,印度喀拉拉邦及卡納塔卡邦今年病例數高於去年同期,印病例數下降; 西太平洋區中國及越南病例數上升,柬埔寨病例數下降; 非洲區中非共和國於9月中公布爆發疫情,多哥疫情亦上升。
unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.en:
Global update: So far this year, more than 13 million cases and 8,500 deaths have been cumulatively reported globally.

Americas: Case numbers are highest in Brazil, followed by Argentina, Mexico, Paraguay and Colombia.

Europe: France, Italy and Spain have reported cases.

Eastern Mediterranean: Iran, Afghanistan and Pakistan have reported cases.

South-East Asia: Case numbers rose in Bangladesh and Nepal. In the Indian states of Kerala and Karnataka, cases this year are higher than in the same period last year. Case numbers in Indonesia declined.

Western Pacific: Case numbers rose in China and Viet Nam and fell in Cambodia.

Africa: The Central African Republic announced an outbreak in mid-September, and cases in Togo also rose.

RAZen0Fms8bDx5DZg8eh3g.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於10/3-10/9期間,巴基斯坦新增4例WPV1病例;共3國新增6例cVDPV2病例,分別為奈及利亞4例、安哥拉/南蘇丹各1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增50件WPV1陽性樣本;共4國新增8件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為日4件、南蘇丹2件、西班牙/葉門各1件;法屬圭亞那新增3件cVDPV3陽性樣本。 全球今年WPV1病例累計50例,其中巴基斯坦28例、阿富汗22例,疾病仍持續傳播並造成兒童健康風險。
RAZen0Fms8bDx5DZg8eh3g.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 3 and 9 October, Pakistan recorded 4 new WPV1 cases. Across 3 countries, 6 new cVDPV2 cases were reported: Nigeria 4, and Angola and South Sudan 1 each. For environmental samples, Pakistan recorded 50 new WPV1-positive samples. Across 4 countries, 8 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported: Japan 4, South Sudan 2, and Spain and Yemen 1 each. French Guiana recorded 3 new cVDPV3-positive samples. Globally this year, cumulative WPV1 cases total 50, including 28 in Pakistan and 22 in Afghanistan. The disease continues to spread and poses health risks to children.

EPRIvZjAW-8GHEsz26etBQ.zh: 歐洲疫情更新,今年截至10/2累計18國報告1,202例本土病例,分布以義大利(422)、希臘(202)、西班牙(114)為多,其中88例死亡,以希臘(31)、義大利(16)、阿爾巴亞(13)為多。今年累計病例數高於去年同期(681),多為65歲以上男性;ECDC指出,隨季節轉換,預期疫情將逐漸趨緩。
EPRIvZjAW-8GHEsz26etBQ.en: In this European update, as of 2 October this year, 18 countries have reported 1,202 locally acquired cases cumulatively, mainly in Italy (422), Greece (202) and Spain (114), with 88 deaths, mainly in Greece (31), Italy (16) and Albania (13). This year's cumulative case count exceeds the same period last year (681), and cases are mostly men aged over 65. ECDC notes that as the season changes, the outbreak is expected to gradually subside.
